definitions.explanation: A person who has been formally invited to an event such as a wedding, party, ceremony, or premiere, as opposed to a paying customer or uninvited attendee.

examples.japanese: {招待客|しょうたいきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{招待客|しょうたいきゃく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百人|ひゃくにん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: The wedding's invited guests numbered over a hundred.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な{招待客|しょうたいきゃく}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Only special invited guests could enter the opening event.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{招待|しょうたい}→招待：01435_shoutai⟧ (invitation) + ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (guest, customer). Specifically a guest who attends by invitation, distinguishing them from ordinary paying customers.

- {招待客|しょうたいきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: welcome the invited guests
- {招待客|しょうたいきゃく}⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧: guest list
- {招待客|しょうたいきゃく}⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧: invited guests only
